```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

# When testing can choose to only use a sample of rows to speed up iterations.
sample_rows = Inf
#sample_rows = 100000
```

Copied from ESP project.

## Import demographics

```{r import_demographics}
# Time: 3 secs (awing)
system.time({
  df = fread(paste0(dir_rpdrml, "RPDRml__demographics.txt"),
             # This could be all rows or a sample of rows.
             nrows = sample_rows) 
})

#  MM rows
dim(df)
```

## Load unshift file

`


```{r load_unshift_file}
# Hyunjoon received from Victor and shared with Chris via MGB Dropbox.
unshift_df = fread(here("data-raw/RPDRml_v2024_1_empi_map.csv"))

str(unshift_df)

# 3 - 12 days
table(unshift_df$random_offset)

# Left join relative to df.
# Time: 1 sec (awing)
system.time({
  df = merge(df, unshift_df, by = "subject_num", all.x = TRUE)
})

# < 1% appear to be missing from few fields right now.
colMeans(is.na(df))

# Still 570 MM rows.
dim(df)

# Clean up
rm(unshift_df)
```

## Clean dates

```{r clean_dates}
head(df)

# No missingness.
mean(is.na(df$random_offset))

# Incorporate the random offset from RPDR-ML
# If it is missing, we'll get a missing value for sstart_date.
df[, date_birth := lubridate::mdy(sbirth_date) + random_offset]
df[, date_death := lubridate::mdy(sdeath_date) + random_offset]

# Range: Dec. 8, 1997 to Nov. 19, 2022
summary(df$date_birth)
```

## Indicator columns

```{r indicator_cols}
df[, .N, by = ethnicity]
df[, hispanic := as.integer(ethnicity == "Hispanic")]
```

## Strings to factors

```{r strings_to_factors}
names(df)
# We'll remove ethnicity so it's not included here.
string_cols = c("gender", "race", "veteran", "marital_status")
df[, (string_cols) := lapply(.SD, factor), .SDcols = string_cols]

rm(string_cols)
```

## Remove extra cols

```{r remove_extra_cols}
remove_cols = c("biobank_subject_id", "cpt_count", "cpt_first_sdate", "icd_first_sdate",
                "ethnicity",
                "visit_count", "fact_count", "icd_count", "notes_ct",
                "random_offset", # merge this in separately if needed.
                "deceased", "sbirth_date", "sdeath_date", # these have alternative cleaned fields
                "biobank_genotyped")

# This line will show a warning in RStudio but we are intentionally leaving the row argument empty.
data.table::set(df, , remove_cols, NULL)
```

## Add demo_ (and geo_) prefix

```{r add_prefix}
demo_cols = c("gender", "race", "veteran", "marital_status", "public_payer", "hispanic")
new_cols = paste0("demo_", demo_cols)
data.table::setnames(df,
                     old = c(demo_cols, "currentzip_medianincome_2010", "current_zip3"),
                     new = c(new_cols, "demo_medianincome_2010", "geo_zip3"))

```

## Save dataset

```{r save_dataset}
dim(df)
names(df)
system.time({
  fst::write.fst(df,
                 here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/demographics.fst")))
})

# Clean up 
rm(sample_rows, remove_cols, demo_cols, new_cols)
gc()
```
